commitsBeforeThisRecord.purpose: Harden reflection-probe synchronization contract with legal-but-render-changing lighting-policy coverage and canonical critical-defect IDs.
Add fail-closed ReflectionLightingCoverageQA for canonical gate mapping and fingerprint coverage requirements.
Advance reflection lighting fingerprint to v3 and hash SummerSun renderMode/bounceIntensity, subtractive shadow color, pixelLightCount and shadowmaskMode.
Bind the reflection-lighting coverage validator into the existing core Visual Gate integrity dependency path.
Refresh Implementation Readiness record without awarding Visual Fidelity points.

problemFound.summary: Reflection synchronization could accept two individually legal lighting-policy states as coherent because several rendering-affecting values were validated for permissibility but were not identity-bound across probe request and still capture. The reflection contract also mapped to two stale noncanonical critical-defect aliases.
problemFound.risk: A realtime cubemap and the subsequent still could both pass source validity checks while using different legal render policy, contaminating Lighting/Material/Cinematic evidence without changing the prior reflection hash.

changes: Updated reflection_probe_capture_sync_contract.json while keeping schema 1.1 backward-compatible; added explicit lighting coverage booleans and replaced stale critical aliases with exact canonical gate IDs.

Added QualityBlockReflectionLightingCoverageQA.cs. It requires exact mapped critical-defect IDs, verifies those IDs exist in visual_fidelity_gate.json, and fail-closes if request/poll/completion/pre-still lighting coverage is weakened.

Updated QualityBlockReflectionLightingStateFingerprint to reflection-lighting-state-v3. The SHA-256 now includes sun.renderMode, sun.bounceIntensity, RenderSettings.subtractiveShadowColor, QualitySettings.pixelLightCount and QualitySettings.shadowmaskMode in addition to existing sun/sky/ambient/shadow/LOD/render-state data.

Bound the new coverage validator into QualityBlockReflectionMaterialPhysicalityBindingQA.ValidateContractConfigOnly, which is already invoked by QualityBlockVisualGateIntegrityQA, so direct core-gate integrity validation cannot silently ignore the new reflection policy.
Updated implementation_readiness.json while keeping the score at 93/100 and Visual Fidelity unscored.

verification.note: No GitHub Actions workflow or commit-status context was available for the substantive head. Source review can establish implementation intent and fail-closed wiring only; it cannot prove Unity API compilation or rendered image quality.

expectedVisualScoreImpactAfterRealRender.impact: Higher evidence coherence: realtime cubemap and still must share the same legal light rendering policy, not merely each satisfy broad validity ranges.
Grazing/Fresnel review is less likely to compare materials against reflections produced under a different legal policy state.
Highlight/exposure review is less likely to be contaminated by stale specular energy from a differently configured reflection capture.
Reflection evidence mapping now uses the exact canonical IDs sun_shadow_inconsistency, major_light_leak and unverified_render_claim; aliases cannot silently become nonbinding documentation.

limitations: The new fields are source/API state observations, not pixel evidence. Matching hashes do not prove physically convincing illumination.
A transient state mutation entirely between observed Editor callbacks remains outside this source-only proof and must be judged with actual runner evidence.
No Unity 6000.3.0f1 compile occurred, so API availability/behavior remains runtime verification pending despite reuse of APIs already present elsewhere in the branch.
No 3840x2160 benchmark stills or 100% crops exist on the branch; Visual Fidelity remains unscored.
nextBlocker: Unity 6000.3.0f1 Runner. When available, stop speculative expansion and run Prepare Complete Native 4K Review Packet. Confirm reflection-lighting-state-v3 remains identical from pre-RenderProbe request through every observed poll, completion and immediate pre-still validation, then score only the sealed hero/oblique/grazing 3840x2160 frames and 100% crops.
